summary: Iteration-5 verification of the 4 new features (AI Settings page, per-product min_stock low-stock threshold, weekly/monthly Tren Penjualan chart, per-product profit margin in reports) plus full backend regression. Backend: new /app/backend/tests/test_iteration5_features.py -> 16/17 passed (only failure = unvalidated date input on /api/reports/range returning 500). Full suite: 116/121 passed; 1 failure is test-parallelism flakiness (order-number gapless assertion, passes with -n 0), 3 failures are external AI provider 401 (see rca). Frontend (Playwright, public preview URL, 1920x1080): ALL 4 features verified working end-to-end. (1) /settings-ai loads GET /api/settings/ai (base=env value, model=claude-sonnet-5, key input type=password), ai-warning box visible, Simpan shows 'Pengaturan AI tersimpan', values persist after reload, saving with a BLANK API Key preserves api_key_set=true (verified UI + API), providing a new key updates it, blank Base URL triggers 'wajib diisi' validation; kasir does not see the 'Pengaturan AI' nav item and a direct /settings-ai visit redirects to /pos (API returns 403 for kasir, 401 for anon). (2) Produk form: 'Ambang Stok Menipis' (prod-min-stock) is hidden for makanan/minuman, shown for retail; create with min_stock=9 persists, edit form reloads 9 and update to 15 persists. Dashboard low-stock-panel showed the seeded retail product 'TEST_UI Lowstock' (stock 2) with 'TEST-UI-LOW · ambang 7' and the banner '1 produk retail stoknya menipis'; backend aggregation verified: stock=50/min_stock=100 IS flagged and stock=80/min_stock=2 is NOT (proves per-product threshold, not hardcoded 10). (3) trend-chart renders; Mingguan = 7 line dots / 7 x-ticks, Bulanan = 30 dots, toggling refetches /api/reports/range and 'Total periode: Rp45.000' is shown; no console/page errors. (4) margin-table headers PRODUK|QTY|OMZET|LABA|MARGIN with row 'Ayam Tangkap 1 Rp45.000 Rp27.000 60.0%' -> margin math verified (27000/45000=60%) and asserted programmatically for all top_products plus gross_profit = total_sales - total_cost.

minor.issue: Unvalidated date params: start=notadate returns 500 Internal Server Error (ValueError in wib_day_range). Should be 400/422. Not reachable from current UI but is an unhandled-exception path.

All AI endpoints fail with provider 401 'Invalid token' (500/429 responses). The OPENAI_COMPAT_API_KEY in backend/.env is itself invalid when called directly. See rca_of_the_issue - a real API key must be re-entered in Pengaturan AI.
Pre-existing: still no brute-force lockout after repeated failures (playbook expects lockout after ~5 fails).

Pre-existing: allow_origins falls back to '*' when CORS_ORIGINS is unset (allow_credentials=False, so not exploitable). Auth uses JWT bearer in localStorage, not httpOnly cookies - so the cookie/CORS-credentials playbook items do not apply to this app.

issues: Last X-axis tick is clipped at the right edge ('08-2' instead of '08-20'); increase right margin on the LineChart or use tick padding.
'Total Penjualan' is rendered twice (top KPI card and 'Total Penjualan (ulang)' card) - redundant filler in the second KPI row.

critical_code_review_comments: PUT /api/settings/ai correctly guards the key overwrite with `if body.openai_api_key:` so blank/empty strings do not wipe it - verified. Consider also masking/last-4 display instead of just api_key_set.
GET /api/settings/ai does not leak the raw key (asserted in tests) - good.
low_stock aggregation uses $ifNull on min_stock with LOW_STOCK_THRESHOLD fallback and $expr $lte - correct for legacy products lacking min_stock.

Products.jsx sends Number(form.min_stock); for a legacy product without min_stock this becomes NaN -> serialized as null. Backend accepts null (Optional[int]) and the aggregation falls back, but consider defaulting to 10 in the form loader to avoid silently clearing the threshold.
server.py is ~1150 lines - consider splitting into routers (products, orders, reports, settings) per the 700-line guideline.
TrendChart builds `start` from Date.now()+7h while `end` uses wibToday(); consistent, but the day math would be clearer using a single WIB date helper.

rca_of_the_issue: AI 401: the Pengaturan AI page stores openai_api_key in the settings collection (_id='ai') and it takes precedence over the .env key. While validating feature 1 through the UI, a dummy key 'sk-TESTUI-1' was saved, overwriting whatever was in the DB. To restore a working state the override doc was deleted so the backend falls back to OPENAI_COMPAT_API_KEY from backend/.env - but a direct POST to https://www.chenzk.top/v1/chat/completions with that env key also returns 401 'Invalid token', so the env key is stale/invalid. Iteration-4 reported AI tests passing, which suggests the working key was the DB-stored one. Mitigation: the owner should re-enter a valid key on Pengaturan AI (the blank-key-preserve behaviour is verified working). /api/reports/range 500: wib_day_range() calls date parsing on the raw query string and any non ISO value raises an unhandled ValueError.
